[[Crown Guard Tower]] is a ruined tower located in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], and an objective in the [[A Game of Towers|Game of Towers]] world PvP event. It is located in the south western part of the map, overlooking the main road. When players capture this tower, anyone in their faction can use a nearby graveyard, located just north of the tower.

Because of its out of the way location, this tower is less likely to be captured by [[Stratholme]] groups doing PvP before a run. Thus, once captured, it has a higher likelyhood of staying captured.
